items.method: Cross-read the single-name options tape (call-versus-put premium, call fraction, and the strike and days-to-expiry of the heaviest same-session prints) against the cash-market internals (market-heatmap breadth versus its 60% threshold, and its change from the prior session) and the options-structure corridor (negative dealer gamma, flip, put and call walls, front expected move), then judge whether a swing back to call-led premium under narrowing breadth is a broad risk-on turn or a short-dated gamma chase, and anchor a direction-correct invalidation to the call wall above spot whose reclaim would falsify the rally-quality caution.
items.note: The genuinely new signature this window is that the derivative tape has rotated back from the two-sided, put-led posture of the prior session to uniformly call-led premium — yet the heaviest prints are almost entirely same-session upside chase rather than positioned conviction. Single-name option premium is call-heavy at a 0.681 call fraction, $2.376B of call premium against $1.113B of put premium across 12 tickers with 1776 contracts clearing the $250k bar inside 30 days, a clear step up in call demand. But the composition is short-dated: the single most unusual print is a same-session SPY 766 call at $78.7M on 58.7x open interest, the second a same-session QQQ 710 call at $76.9M, and the third a same-session MSFT 495 call — every top print is zero-days-to-expiry and struck at or just above spot, the fingerprint of intraday gamma chase, not a durable directional bid. This lands on a cash tape that is narrowing, not broadening: market-heatmap breadth is 41.72% of 134 constituents positive, an 18.28-point miss of the 60% broad-participation line and a step down from the prior read, so the call-led premium is being paid into a shrinking cohort of leaders. The options structure is mechanically fragile — SPY is in negative dealer gamma with spot near 766.08 wedged between the 765 put wall and the 770 call wall, fractionally under the 766.28 flip, inside a wide plus-or-minus 21.22 front expected move, while the most recent intraday auction was a Mixed / developing session pinned to a 765.64 VWAP. Call-led, zero-dated premium concentrating at the money under deteriorating breadth in negative gamma is a low-quality-rally read on the index rather than a broad risk-on turn, so the caution here is on rally quality. Watch a decisive reclaim of the 766.28 flip and the 770 call wall as the confirming trigger that would flip dealers positive and validate the bullish flow; the rally-quality caution is invalidated on a daily close above ~770.00 on SPY, which clears the call wall and releases the corridor upward.
items.title: The single-name options tape has flipped back to one-sided, call-led premium this window even as cash breadth narrows further — flow is call-heavy at a 0.681 call fraction ($2.376B calls vs $1.113B puts across 12 names, 1776 contracts clearing the $250k bar inside 30 days) and the single most unusual print is a same-session SPY 766 call at $78.7M on 58.7x open interest, printed alongside a $76.9M QQQ 710 call, while breadth has fallen to 41.72% of 134 constituents and SPY sits in negative dealer gamma just below the 766.28 flip between the 765 put wall and the 770 call wall

items.method: Cross-read three independent internals — the sector RRG rotation states and accelerations, the real-assets 0-100 composite leadership across crypto, broad commodity, oil and the monetary metals, and the market-heatmap breadth versus its 60% threshold — to test whether a risk-on leadership rotation is firming against the narrow breadth, then, finding no direction-correct price level on a single committed-universe instrument that expresses the cluster, withhold a tactical call rather than publish one that cannot be scored.
items.note: The second cross-model pattern this window is a risk-on rotation cluster that sits in tension with, rather than alongside, the narrowing cash breadth. The sector model is rotating leadership toward communications — XLC is Improving with acceleration +5.27 and healthcare XLV is Leading at +2.26 — while financials XLF weakens and rotates out. The real-assets model reinforces the risk-on read: crypto leads with ETH-USD at 76.6/100, bitcoin (BTC-USD) at 69.5 and IBIT at 61.9 all in uptrends, and broad commodities are firm with DBC and PDBC both 64.8 and oil (USO) a 55.0 uptrend, while the defensive monetary metals lag — gold (GLD) reads 47.5 with six-month momentum of -11.01% and silver (SLV) is weak at 22.6. Improving communications and crypto leadership with firm broad commodities is a coherent speculative-appetite signature that argues against reading the narrow 41.72% breadth as uniformly defensive. This is a structural observation, not a scoreable trade: the cluster does not resolve to a single committed-universe instrument with a direction-correct price level this window — the sector reads are relative-strength and rotation states, the real-assets reads are 0-100 composite scores, and neither is a price trigger — so a tactical call is withheld rather than published with only a working side. Watch whether breadth reclaims the 60% participation line to confirm the risk-on rotation, or whether XLC leadership fades back toward defensives; until an instrument-level price trigger is in view, the cluster is carried as counter-weight evidence to the index-level rally-quality caution, not as its own call.
items.title: A risk-on rotation cluster is firming underneath the narrow breadth this window — sector leadership is improving into communications (XLC Improving, accel +5.27) with healthcare leading (XLV Leading, accel +2.26) as financials weaken (XLF Weakening), and real assets lead with crypto (ETH-USD 76.6, BTC-USD 69.5, IBIT 61.9) and firm broad commodities (DBC and PDBC 64.8) while gold (GLD 47.5, six-month momentum -11.01%) and silver (SLV 22.6) lag — a cross-model tension with the 41.72% breadth read that resolves to no single committed-universe price level
